info.title: RAN Online GS Payments & Recharge API
info.description: Source-derived contract for the gs-api player payment endpoints (/api/v1/payments), the PayPal and PayMongo webhooks, and the administrator recharge endpoints (/admin/v1/recharge). Documents current behavior, including known quirks (see errors.md). Players authenticate with an actix-session cookie; administrators with an HS256 bearer JWT. Request bodies are not strict: unknown JSON fields are ignored. Examples are fixtures, not production records. See README.md.

servers.description: gs-api origin (local dev binds APP_HOST:APP_PORT, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:5010)

get.description: Returns every RechargeInfo row with RechargeStatus = 1 as a bare JSON array. No session is read; the cookie session middleware still wraps the scope but never rejects. No pagination, no ordering clause (SQL Server row order), no caching (the generic cache is a TODO). The `type` of each package decides which payment method POST /transaction/{id} will use.

get.summary: Read one recharge package by ID
get.description: Returns the RechargeInfo row regardless of its status (inactive packages are readable here). A nil UUID (all zeroes) returns 400. A missing row is reported as 500, not 404, because the DB layer returns an error that the handler maps to 500.

post.summary: Start a recharge purchase for one package
post.description:
Requires a signed-in user session whose profile has is_verified = true. Loads the RechargeInfo by path ID, then dispatches on RechargeInfo.type:

- 1 GCash: body REQUIRED, `{"type":"gcash",...}`. Inserts a pending WebTransaction (type 1) with reference code and optional proof image; an administrator approves it later.
- 2 PayPal: body MUST BE ABSENT. Inserts a pending WebTransaction (type 2), creates a PayPal order (USD, intent CAPTURE, invoice_id = transaction UUID) and returns the PayPal approval URL. The PayPal webhook settles it.
- 3 Wise: body REQUIRED, `{"type":"wise",...}`. Inserts a pending WebTransaction (type 3) with reference code; an administrator approves it later.
- 4 PayMongo: body MUST BE ABSENT. Inserts a pending WebTransaction (type 4), creates a PayMongo checkout session (PHP centavos, card + gcash, metadata.transaction_id = transaction UUID) and returns its checkout URL as approval_url. The PayMongo webhook settles it.

The body extractor is Option<Json<TransactionPayload>>: an unparseable, wrong-content-type or oversized (>2 MiB actix default) body is silently treated as absent. Sending a body to a PayPal/PayMongo package, or the wrong tag for the package type, returns 400 'Invalid transaction data'. A Discord notification is spawned after GCash/Wise inserts. Points are credited only when the transaction status later becomes 1 (database trigger trg_AddWebPoints).

requestBody.description: Required for GCash (type 1) and Wise (type 3) packages; must be omitted for PayPal (type 2) and PayMongo (type 4).

gcash_with_proof.summary: GCash package (type 1) with base64 proof image

200.description: Shape depends on the package type: TransactionAccepted for GCash/Wise, PayPalApproval for PayPal, PayMongoCheckoutCreated for PayMongo.

400.description: Body validation failed (`error` key: 'Reference number cannot be empty', 'Proof image is too large', 'Invalid image format'), body missing for GCash/Wise (`message`: 'Missing transaction data'), or body/type mismatch (`message`: 'Invalid transaction data'). All variants include recharge_info.

403.description: Session user has not verified their email.

example.message: Email verification required to use this feature

404.description: Recharge package not found, nil UUID, or any DB error while loading it (all collapse to the same response). A non-UUID path segment returns actix's plain-text 404 instead.

422.description: PayPal/PayMongo only: inserting the pending WebTransaction failed.

500.description: No session (`message`: 'No session found' — not 401), GCash/Wise insert failure (`message`: 'Error processing request' + recharge_info; this includes a proof_image that is not plain base64), PayPal order build/create failure (`error` + `details`), PayPal approval link missing (`error`), or PayMongo API failure (`message` + recharge_info).

get.description: Returns GatewayInfo rows with GatewayStatus = 1 (filtered in Rust after SELECT *). Gateways are the account details (name, number, QR/logo image) a player pays into for manual methods such as GCash. Rows whose GatewayImage is NULL are silently skipped by the row parser.

get.summary: List the signed-in user's own transactions
get.description: Requires a user session. Loads every WebTransaction of session.user_num ordered by TransactionTime DESC, filters in memory by `status` and `category` (= transaction type), then paginates in memory. `search`, `start_date`, `end_date` are accepted but ignored. Results are cached per (user_num, page, limit) for 30 seconds; the cache stores the unfiltered list, so filter changes apply immediately but newly created transactions can take up to 30 s to appear.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Keep only this transaction type (payment method).

200.description: One page of the user's transactions.

post.description:
Server-to-server, called by PayPal. NO signature verification is performed (the HMAC verifier is commented out), so anyone who can reach the URL can post events. Body is parsed as free-form JSON; only the fields in PayPalWebhookEvent are read. The handler checks, in order: `resource` present, `resource.id` string present, `event_type` present, then dispatches:

- CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED: captures the order through the PayPal API using resource.id. Does NOT change the transaction status; the later PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED does. Invalidates the buyer's profile cache when the invoice ID resolves.
- PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED: sets the transaction (invoice ID) to status 1 → trigger credits points; invalidates the profile cache.
- CHECKOUT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED: same branch, but its status mapping is 0, so it updates Pending→Pending (no effect).
- PAYMENT.CAPTURE.DENIED / PAYMENT.CAPTURE.DECLINED: sets status 2; update failures are only logged.
- anything else: acknowledged, not processed.

The transaction UUID (invoice ID) is read from resource.invoice_id, else resource.purchase_units[0].invoice_id, else resource.custom. Status updates only apply to Pending (0) rows; a repeat delivery after settlement fails the update and returns 500 for the COMPLETED branch.

200.description: Processed or acknowledged. message is one of 'Webhook processed successfully', 'Capture successful', 'Payment declined webhook received', 'Webhook received, but not processed'.

400.description: Missing resource / resource.id / event_type, missing invoice ID on a COMPLETED event, or an invoice ID that is not a UUID. Malformed JSON returns actix plain text.

415.description: Content-Type is not application/json (actix JSON extractor).

500.description: Status update failed on a COMPLETED event (including the transaction is no longer Pending), or the PayPal capture call failed. PayPal retries non-2xx deliveries.

post.description:
Server-to-server, called by PayMongo. NO signature verification (PayMongo-Signature check is commented out). The raw body is read as UTF-8 and parsed as PayMongoWebhookPayload. Event type = data.attributes.type:

- payment.paid: sets the transaction to status 1 → trigger credits points.
- payment.failed: sets the transaction to status 2.
- anything else: ignored.

The transaction UUID is data.attributes.data.attributes.metadata.transaction_id (copied by PayMongo from the checkout session metadata set at purchase). The handler ALWAYS answers 200 text/plain 'Webhook received and processed' once the payload parses — including unknown events, a missing transaction_id, and failed status updates — so PayMongo never retries those. The buyer's profile cache is NOT invalidated here (unlike PayPal).

200.description: Always this body once the payload parses, whatever happened afterwards.

400.description: Body is not UTF-8 ('Invalid UTF-8 payload'), does not match PayMongoWebhookPayload ('Invalid payload format'), inner attributes lack `metadata` ('Error processing payment.paid event' / 'Error processing payment.failed event') — all text/plain — or metadata.transaction_id is not a UUID (JSON, note the trailing space in the message).

get.summary: Search and page all transactions (multi-value filters)
get.description:
Primary admin transaction list. Query is parsed with serde_qs (max depth 5, non-strict, so percent-encoded brackets are accepted). Multi-value filters use bracket notation: `?status[]=0&status[]=1&method[]=1&method[]=4` (indexed `status[0]=0` also works). Empty arrays mean no filter. Calls sp_GetWebTransactions: `search` matches UserName LIKE '%search%' OR RefferenceCode = search; rows sort Pending first, then TransactionTime DESC.

PAGINATION QUIRK: the procedure computes OFFSET = page × limit, so it is effectively 0-based. page=1 (the default) skips the first `limit` rows; send page=0 for the first page. page/limit are cast from usize to i16 (truncating); limit is not clamped. Response has no total_pages.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: SQL page index; OFFSET = page × limit (see quirk).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: UserName substring or exact reference code.

400.description: serde_qs could not parse the query string.

get.description: Loads ALL WebTransaction rows (or all rows with the given status) ordered by TransactionTime DESC, then filters `category` and `search` and paginates in memory. `search` matches when user_name CONTAINS it (case-sensitive), or equals the transaction_id string, or equals reference_code. start_date/end_date are accepted but ignored. Every row's proof image is base64-encoded into the response. Prefer GET /admin/v1/recharge.

put.summary: Approve or decline a pending transaction
put.description: The new status is a QUERY parameter, not a body (any body is ignored). Only rows still Pending (0) are updated; anything else returns 500. Setting 1 fires trigger trg_AddWebPoints, which adds transaction_amount (points) to the buyer's WebUser.WebPoints. Any i16 is accepted (no range check); use 1 (approve) or 2 (decline). On success: the buyer's profile cache is invalidated and a Discord embed is posted to env DISCORD_TRANSACTION_WEBHOOK (skipped if unset). The approving administrator is not recorded (TODO in code) and admin_remarks is not written.

400.description: status query missing or not an integer (actix plain text).

404.description: Path is not a UUID (actix plain text).

500.description: Transaction missing or no longer Pending (anyhow message passed through), or database failure.

put.description: Full replacement of type, amount, points and status. `discount` is accepted but NOT written (absent from the UPDATE SET clause); the returned row shows the stored discount. Returns the updated row (OUTPUT inserted.*). The handler is registered twice in configure(); only the first registration is reachable.

404.description: Path is not a UUID (actix plain text).

500.description: Package not found or database failure.

put.description: Full replacement of every field including the image. `image` MUST be valid standard base64: invalid base64 panics inside the DB layer (`.unwrap()`), dropping the connection without an HTTP response. Returns the updated row.

404.description: Path is not a UUID (actix plain text).

500.description: Gateway not found or database failure (message text says 'recharge info').

get.description: All GatewayInfo rows regardless of status, as a bare array. Rows with a NULL image are skipped by the row parser.

post.description: Inserts a GatewayInfo row (ID generated by the database). `number` MUST parse as i64 (digits only, no leading +) and `image` MUST be valid standard base64; either failure panics (`.unwrap()`), dropping the connection without an HTTP response. The new ID is not returned.

get.description: Filters in SQL by `status` (RechargeStatus; cast i16→u8, so negative values wrap) and `category` (RechargeType), then paginates in memory. A page beyond the last page is clamped to the last page. limit is not clamped. Response has no page/limit echo.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page; clamped to the last page. page=0 underflows (debug panic / release empty data).

post.description: Inserts a RechargeInfo row with inline SQL in the handler (RechargeID defaults to NEWSEQUENTIALID()). `discount` is written only when present and non-null. The new ID is not returned.

UserSessionCookie.name: YXGames
UserSessionCookie.description: actix-session CookieSessionStore cookie. Name comes from env COOKIE_NAME (YXGames in the reviewed .env). Private (encrypted) content, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure unless WEB_DOMAIN ends with .local, Domain = WEB_DOMAIN. Set by the user login endpoint (/api/v1/auth, outside this contract); the session key `user_data` holds a ProfileData. Browsers must send credentials (fetch credentials: 'include'). A missing/expired session makes the handler return 500 {"message":"No session found"}.

AdminBearerJWT.description: HS256 JWT signed with env SESSION_SECRET, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (prefix is case-sensitive). Claims {sub: string, role: string, exp: unix seconds}; only signature and exp are checked — JwtMiddleware performs NO role check. Issued by POST /admin/v1/auth/authenticate (outside this contract). Failure returns 401 text/plain 'Authorization token missing or invalid'.

PaymentsRechargeId.name: id
PaymentsRechargeId.description: RechargeInfo.id (RechargeID). A value that is not a UUID fails path extraction with actix's plain-text 404.

PaymentsPage.name: page
PaymentsPage.description: 1-based page. page=0 underflows `page - 1`: panic in debug builds (overflow-checks), empty `data` in release builds.

PaymentsLimit.name: limit
PaymentsLimit.description: Page size; values above 100 are clamped to 100.

PaymentsFetchFailed.description: Database failure (or, for the by-ID route, row not found).

PaymentsPathNotParsed.description: Path segment is not a UUID; actix path extractor returns plain text.

PaymentsBadQuery.description: A query value has the wrong type (e.g. page=abc); actix query extractor returns plain text.

examples: Query deserialize error: invalid digit found in string

AdminUnauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, wrongly signed or expired admin JWT (JwtMiddleware).

example.error: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.

AdminBadJson.description: Malformed JSON or wrong field types (actix plain text). Wrong Content-Type returns 415; >2 MiB returns 413.

TransactionType.description: Payment method. 1 = GCash (manual, proof + reference, admin approval), 2 = PayPal (redirect, webhook settlement, USD), 3 = Wise (manual, reference, admin approval), 4 = PayMongo (redirect, webhook settlement, PHP). Used by RechargeInfo.type, AddRechargeInfo.type and WebTransactionResponse.transaction_type. Stored as SMALLINT; there is no Rust enum, only these literal values in the dispatch match.

TransactionStatus.description: 0 = Pending (DB default on insert), 1 = Approved (trigger trg_AddWebPoints adds TransactionAmount to WebUser.WebPoints on the 0→1 change), 2 = Declined/Cancelled. Only Pending rows can change status.

RecordStatus.description: Visibility flag for RechargeInfo and GatewayInfo rows. 1 = active (returned by the player endpoints). Any other value hides the row from players; the code assigns no other meaning.

amount.description: RechargeAmount: real-money price. Currency is implied by type: PayPal charges USD, PayMongo charges PHP (amount × 100 centavos); GCash/Wise are paid manually.

discount.description: RechargeDiscount (MONEY; the table script declares NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, so 0.0 is the usual 'no discount' value). Display-only; never applied to the charged amount. Always present; null only if the live column allows NULL.

points.description: RechargePoints: R-Coin (web points) credited on approval.

GatewayInfo.description: Account details a player pays into for a manual method (table GatewayInfo).

provider.description: GatewayProvider. No mapping exists in code or SQL; treat as an opaque code (frontends conventionally reuse TransactionType values).

image.description: GatewayImage bytes as standard base64 (no data: prefix), e.g. a QR code.

WebTransactionResponse.description: One purchase attempt (table WebTransaction), with the proof image re-encoded to base64.

transaction_id.description: TransactionID. Also the PayPal invoice_id and PayMongo metadata.transaction_id / reference_number.

transaction_time.description: TransactionTime (DB DATETIME, interpreted in the API server's local timezone) serialized RFC 3339 with offset.

transaction_amount.description: TransactionAmount = RechargeInfo.points (R-Coin to credit). Despite the name this is NOT money.

proof_image.description: ProofImage bytes as standard base64, no data: prefix. GCash only.

admin_remarks.description: AdminRemarks. No endpoint in this contract writes it.

TransactionPage.description: Paginated transaction list with computed total_pages (json! macro, no Rust struct).

limit.description: Effective page size after clamping to 100.

total_pages.description: ceil(total_items / limit); 1 when there are no items.

reference_number.description: GCash reference number. Must be non-blank after trim. Stored in RefferenceCode NVARCHAR(50): longer values fail the insert (500). Not checked for uniqueness (the duplicate check is commented out).

proof_image.description: Receipt screenshot as plain standard base64 WITHOUT a data: prefix. Validation lets a data:image... string through, but the DB layer then fails to decode it and the request returns 500. Max 5,000,000 characters by validation; the actix JSON limit (2 MiB) applies first.

reference_number.description: Wise transfer reference. Must be non-blank after trim. Stored in RefferenceCode NVARCHAR(50).

TransactionPayload.description: Serde internally tagged enum: #[serde(tag = "type", rename_all = "lowercase")]. The variant fields sit next to `type` at the top level.

TransactionAccepted.description: GCash/Wise success (json! macro). The created transaction ID is NOT returned.

data.description: The submitted GCashTransaction or WiseTransaction echoed back (without the `type` tag). GCash echoes proof_image (null when omitted).

PayPalApproval.description: PayPal success (json! macro). Redirect the browser to approval_url. PayPal returns the buyer to env PAYPAL_RETURN_URL / PAYPAL_CANCEL_URL.

approval_url.description: PayPal order link with rel = approve.

PayMongoCheckoutCreated.description: PayMongo success (json! macro). Redirect the browser to approval_url. PayMongo returns the buyer to env PAYMONGO_SUCCESS_URL / PAYMONGO_CANCEL_URL.

examples.message: Email verification required to use this feature

details.description: PayPal failures only: Debug/Display text of the underlying error.

PayPalWebhookEvent.description: PayPal webhook event. Only the listed fields are read; everything else PayPal sends is ignored.

event_type.description: CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED, PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED, CHECKOUT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED, PAYMENT.CAPTURE.DENIED, PAYMENT.CAPTURE.DECLINED are handled; others are acknowledged.

id.description: Order ID (order events) or capture ID (capture events). Used for the capture call on CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED.

invoice_id.description: Capture events: our WebTransaction.transaction_id. Checked first.

purchase_units.description: Order events: purchase_units[0].invoice_id is checked second.

type.description: Rust field object_type, renamed to "type". Normally "event".
Rust field event_type, renamed to "type". payment.paid and payment.failed are handled.

PaymentDataAttributes.x-rust-type: PaymentDataAttributes (deserialized from serde_json::Value for handled events only)
PaymentDataAttributes.description: Only `metadata` is read. Its Rust type is serde_json::Value (not Option), so the key must be present for handled events.

transaction_id.description: WebTransaction.transaction_id, set by POST /transaction/{id} when it created the checkout session.

AddRechargeInfo.description: Create/replace body for a recharge package. No validator rules: negative or zero values are accepted.

amount.description: Real-money price (USD for PayPal, PHP for PayMongo).

discount.description: Display-only. Written on create only; ignored on update.

AddGatewayInfo.description: Create/replace body for a gateway. All fields required.

number.description: Account number (column NVARCHAR(MAX)). Create parses it to i64 first and panics if it is not an integer; because the parsed integer is what gets stored, leading zeros are lost on create ("09171234567" is stored as "9171234567"). Update stores the string unchanged.

image.description: Standard base64 image bytes, no data: prefix. Invalid base64 panics.

PaginationParams.description: Shared query struct (actix web::Query, serde_urlencoded: single values only). search/start_date/end_date are ignored by the endpoints in this contract except admin /recharge-logs, which uses search.

x-source-authority: actix-web handlers, Serde types, tiberius row mapping, and SQL; no inferred endpoints.
